description: This file defines the LogNode interface for a logging system within an Android project. It specifies a method for printing log data and describes a chainable logging mechanism that can include filters or multiple output targets.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a node in a logging chain, capable of outputting log messages and passing them to subsequent nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable object.
